title: Reconcile payments against invoices
person: A bookkeeper checking a month of customer payments.
review: Every invoice and payment from the three inputs is kept.
Paid and Open are formulas over the Payments sheet; statuses and the open total are correct.
The INV-1040 payment is on the Unmatched sheet; the overpayment is flagged, not netted.
Readable labels and currency with no clipped columns.
revised_review: INV-1043 is Paid and the open total falls to 135.00.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.

All five invoices and all five payments appear with their original references, parties, dates and amounts; at the revision stage the 2026-10-02 INV-1043 payment of 920.00 is added and nothing else changes.

First stage: INV-1041 Paid (open 0.00), INV-1042 Part paid (paid 300.00, open 180.00), INV-1043 Unpaid (open 920.00), INV-1044 Paid, INV-1045 Overpaid (paid 650.00, open -45.00 or flagged as 45.00 overpaid); open total 1055.00 (or 1100.00 receivable with the 45.00 overpayment shown separately). Revision stage: INV-1043 Paid and the open total 135.00 (or 180.00 with the overpayment separate).
The 95.00 payment referenced INV-1040 is on the Unmatched sheet and counted against no invoice; the INV-1045 overpayment is flagged, not written off, netted against another invoice or moved.
After raising the INV-1042 payment by EUR 10 in a copy, recalculation in LibreOffice raises INV-1042 Paid EUR by EUR 10.
Printed, each sheet fits on one page, so the PDF has no more pages than the workbook has sheets.
Sheets, headers, currency and statuses are clearly labelled and readable.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; no customer inputs.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
